method: Read current instructions, repository context, saved problem, four packets, both overviews, checkpoint extraction and four independent reviews. Independently checked integrated claim scope and resource arithmetic; file-reading/hashing only, with no original program, pickle, certificate, simulation, fit or replay executed.

checks.reason: All four current proof SHA256 hashes exactly match their individual accepted reviews.

Stationary closure, conditional physical inequalities, finite-cell/tail recipes, frozen-design bias, full score and precision, thermal model choice, path-dependent aging and cumulative replacement claims retain their premises. Neither overview converts recipes or reported checkpoints into a certified feasible map.

Three continuous RC branches, uncertain incoming states, SOC/Q/H, both unknown directional rates, physical chronological transport and all joint cross terms remain explicit. Known-gamma simplification is rejected as the full-model solution.

12 hysteresis + 3 affine + 1 datum coordinates give W=Nu+rf+16. Nu=13,rf=7 yields W=36 and 666 packed scalars: 5328 B binary64 or 2664 B binary32. 13*27=351 map scalars: 2808/1404 B. p=16 symmetric moment has 136 scalars=1088 B binary64. These are illustrative payloads, not lower bounds or complete target allocations; shared 13-pole coverage is unproved.

Overviews preserve U1 requirement that Jacobians be evaluated at final query, or recovered by proved fixed-feature contractions. WCS per-component matrices and lifted moments are explicitly charged; CS/L1 savings are not claimed equivalent in utility.

Checkpoint extraction explicitly marks every supplied numerical result unverified, with no binding to A, arithmetic or source program. It is labelled a selected extraction rather than original artifact archive. This review makes no independent numeric validation claim.

checks.claim: No lifetime inference from local results
checks.reason: Local Laplace trigger, seven-day float32 result, finite response envelope, local precision and posterior plug-in boxes are all denied unconditional lifetime/coverage authority. Complete hardware resources and thermal/aging adequacy remain open.
Artifacts are symbolic reconstruction and review only; no original numerical rerun or unsafe unpickling was performed in this review. No estimator changes or promotion are represented.

nonblocking_findings.disposition: Both integrated disposition table and provenance report explicitly say the incoming inverse scaling was correct; the individual review caveat is preserved. No mathematics change or reopening required.

nonblocking_findings.disposition: D1 individual review limitations remain binding. Overviews only claim propagation obligations and missing dynamics, not completed joint sensitivity or aging certificates.

limits: Accepts only hash-bound symbolic integration and exact arithmetic counts; does not establish feasible coefficients, numerical tolerances, physical coverage, sustained utility, full-model closure, complete SRAM, timing or deployment.

Receipt and subsequent root metadata are administrative follow-up and not included in these bindings. Historical root context hashes in individual reviews must remain associated with their source snapshot.
No new proof replaces the four individual reviews; substantive changes require renewed independent review.
